notes.title: Your building journey starts on August 17th with Hello Engineer!
notes.content:
Hello Hello, everybody!

[h3]The countdown to the Hello Engineer launch has begun! Prepare yourselves for a thrilling engineering experience coming your way on August 17th.[/h3] 

https://youtu.be/DNwxrxs-sb4
Welcome to Hello Engineer, a multiplayer machinery-construction game set in the Hello Neighbor universe, built for up to 4 players! Construct incredible machines using scrap, and prepare to face off against your creepy Neighbor and his army of evil bots. 

And guess what? We're offering an unbeatable [b]35% launch discount for the first week after the launch[/b]. Plus, if you're already a Hide and Seek fan and own the game, you'll receive [b]an exclusive 15% loyalty discount[/b] on Hello Engineer! Stack these discounts and embark on a unique journey through the world of engineering!

⏳ Mark your calendars and [b]wishlist[/b] the game to be the first! 

[h3]⚙️Play the Demo while waiting for the full release on Steam! Scavenge, craft, and invent ingenious vehicles![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856190/Hello_Engineer/

notes.title: Moustaches & Mysteries - Hello Neighbor 2 is Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EEDpbLg.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][h3]Ready your cameras and prepare to begin your investigation![/h3]

[h2]Hello Neighbor 2 is Available Now![/h2]

It's time to renew your investigation and return to the sleepy little town with a [i]bit[/i] of a missing person problem and a [b]whole[/b] a lot of mystery. Can you get to the bottom of what's really going on in Raven Brooks? Dive deeper into the town's dark secrets and uncover new sides to the story of how Mr. Peterson became "The Neighbor." 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321680/Hello_Neighbor_2/
[hr][/hr]
[h3][u]Attend the exclusive advance viewing of Welcome to Raven Brooks[/u][/h3]

Want to see Hello Neighbor Animated Series: Welcome to Raven Brooks before anyone else? Simply start up your last Hello Neighbor 2 save! Yes, you heard that right, we are [i]literally[/i] throwing the exclusive premiere of Welcome To Raven Brooks, [u][b]from inside[/b] Raven brooks! [/u]

So when you come across a strange television set with a countdown timer on it, go ahead and grab some popcorn and snacks before the big show! And if you missed the initial showing don't worry!

[u][h3][url=https://youtu.be/z0MZRMp0nxA][b]You can catch the replay on our YouTube channel Dec 11th at 10:00AM PT![/b][/url][/h3][/u]
[quote][h2]Game Editions[/h2]
[h3]Hello Neighbor 2: Deluxe Edition[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/8abd7c0d41bd40ed5d232fb8d78a873c0ce9037f.png[/img]
[h3]Level up your investigative tools, meet new Neighbors, & explore new locations + puzzles with the Hello Neighbor 2 Deluxe Edtion! [/h3]

[b]The Hello Neighbor 2 Deluxe Edition includes 3 day-one DLC:[/b]

📚 [b]Late Fees[/b]- Will you uncover something sinister in the endless maze of books that is the Raven Brooks Library? Only one way to find out!

🏫 [b]Back To School[/b] - Investigate the sprawling Raven Brooks Middle School for clues. But beware the creepy janitor and his fiendish 4-legged friends!

🚁 [b]Hello-copter[/b] - Surveil your Neighbors in style! This top-of-the-line gadget lets you spy on your suspects from safety and pilfer items with its retractable grappling claw!
[/quote]
[h2]Watch the launch day trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=RvUEaHljElg;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
Elevate your experience and increase your immersion with CORSAIR's iCUE technology. Synchronizing the RGB lighting on all your compatible CORSAIR devices gives you a setup-wide light show to go with your small-town-wide sneaking. 🔎

Before we sign off, I'd like to take a moment to say a big, heartfelt [b]thank you[/b] on behalf of the team to our amazing community of Neighbors near and far, both past and present! Thank you all for being right there with us playing through every new build, demo, and alpha over the past 5 years. We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed developing it, and [u]please stay tuned for updates and post-launch news. [/u]

As always, we’ll see you in Raven Brooks.

Cheers!

notes.title: tinyBuild's hosting a carnival of games at PAXSouth
notes.content:
[img]https://imgur.com/ZCsV3pc.gif[/img]

Hello gamers! 

I've not been posting much to our publisher page because cross-posting is currently very wonky, so it's been mostly to individual pages of games.

This weekend we're hosting a full on orange Carnival at PAXSouth, featuring lots and lots of games!

[h1]Secret Neighbor[/h1]

Secret Neighbor is getting a full on booth, so come over to say hi and show the game to your friends. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/859570/Secret_Neighbor/

[h1]Black Skylands[/h1]

I believe Black Skylands has best in class pixelart, and gameplay to match. The newest demo takes you on a journey through gorgeous floating islands filled with things that want you dead.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1143810/Black_Skylands/

[h1]Totally Reliable Delivery Service[/h1]

Delivery attempted. That's the guarantee of this totally accurate representation of package delivery drivers. We've all had this happen to us, so now it's time to make fun of it in a physics filled sandbox!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1011670/Totally_Reliable_Delivery_Service/

[h1]Hellpoint[/h1]

The latest build of Hellpoint showcases the "Dark Souls in Space" game's progress, and we're eager to see what fans think

https://store.steampowered.com/app/628670/Hellpoint/

[h1]Merch! Fun! Attractions![/h1]

Aside from actual games we have a whole setup for fun family friendly activities, featuring merch you can win. 

[img]https://imgur.com/9FwilNg.png[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/xV5LEWT.png[/img]

notes.title: Secret Neighbor coming Oct 24 / Pre-Alpha of HN live
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1es15gx.gif[/img]

Good news, everyone!

Secret Neighbor, the multiplayer spin-off of Hello Neighbor, is coming to Steam on October 24th. That's exactly in 2 weeks!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LH4FkwV.gif[/img]

Remember to Wishlist the game so you're notified of when it launches: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/859570/Secret_Neighbor/

[h1]To celebrate the anticipated launch, we are launching the Alphas on Steam[/h1]

I know many of you have been waiting for the release of the original Hello Neighbor Alphas. It's 2 weeks until launch of Secret Neighbor, and there are 5 alpha builds. I will be launching a new alpha every few days leading up to launch. 

The Alphas of Hello Neighbor were a series of game builds we used to test out the original game's gameplay, setting, lore, and AI. They show the logical evolution of how the game became Hello Neighbor. 

I just launched the first Pre-Alpha build. Enjoy:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1092700/Hello_Neighbor_PreAlpha/
